Upload a .corpus, .zip, .ctei, or .cusx archive of at most 3 MB. A verified Supabase user token is required. Text-Fabric archives run real Text-Fabric and Context-Fabric load cycles; invalid supported archives return 200 with valid=false and reasons. The path field is the uploaded filename. Server paths, loaded corpus names, and legacy conversion job IDs are not accepted by this hosted endpoint.
